name: Jurdns iterative noise KSampler (callback noise injection)
plain: A KSampler that adds fresh Gaussian noise to the latent from inside the progress callback every N steps, scaled by the current sigma and a strength that ramps linearly from start to end over the run. It works by adding in place to the x tensor the sampler hands to the callback, so the effect depends on the sampler passing its live latent there (core Euler-family samplers do, before their update). Surprise: the sigma used for scaling comes from a full schedule computed without denoise, so with denoise below 1 it does not match the sigmas actually sampled.
math:
Symbols: i step index; T total steps; σ_i from calculate_sigmas(scheduler, steps); s_0, s_1 start and end strength.
if i>0 and i mod N = 0: s = s_0 + (s_1−s_0)·i/(T−1); x ← x + s·σ_i·ε_i, ε_i ~ N(0,I) seeded seed+i+1 on the GPU.

props.params: add_noise_every_n_steps 1, start_noise_strength 0.1, end_noise_strength 0.0, plus KSampler inputs
